description: Upload a token logo through Lockwood's moderation gate (the SAME gate the UI uses — no bypass). Give a local image file path (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF); it is re-encoded, screened, and either rejected (explicit/illegal content) or stored. Returns { url, nsfw }. Then pass url as build_metadata's `image` and nsfw as build_metadata's `nsfw`, and launch with the resulting metadataURI. Requires the image service (IMAGE_SERVICE_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:3000).

imagePath.description: Local path to a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF logo file

name: set_image
